title: Fables, reworked as modern-day fables (three, moral line only)
summary:

**1. The Napkin (Ten People, One Idea)** - nine team leads send the same polished idea; the real fix was in Pete's napkin draft.
**2. Let Me Get Back to You (The Chat Is Not Your Memory)** - Theo's three-month chat makes up a reason nobody said.
**3. The Friendly Room (Assemble the Team)** - "Compelling," said the AI; the investor asked one question.

Full text in the file (each under 150 words). No team run (your rule: a team runs only after you confirm it at 4 PM).
